description:
[Game reference] Rust seasonal events: Advent Calendar by day, birthday, Christmas, Halloween, Easter. From the server code. `advent`: `days` (Dec 16-25) with `rewards`, `primitive` alternatives and `by_era` (what
Primitive/Medieval/Frontier/Modern servers give or skip), `rules`, `clock` (server-clock dates), the calendar `item`.
`birthday`: Dec 7-16 window, cake + party hat. `christmas`: `rules`, `convars`, `presents`/`stockings`/`gift_box`
loot odds (`chance_pct`, `min`/`max`), `tree`, `dungeon`, sleigh. `halloween`/`easter`: hunts, prizes, convars.
`status`: whether the dated events are on now (UTC) or days until they start. `how_servers_switch_it_on`: commands.
Every rule has a `source` (decompiled file:line or prefab). event=advent for the calendar by day. Dates are by the server's own clock (usually UTC). Link https://rust.wiki/advent-calendar, /christmas, /birthday-event or /seasonal-events.
name: get_seasonal_events
title: Rust seasonal events: Advent Calendar by day, birthday, Christmas, Halloween, Easter
